8.7.1 Mandatory Interfaces
This subsection defines all interfaces that are required to fulfill the core functionality of
the module.
[SWS_J1939Nm_00040] Definition of mandatory interfaces in module J1939Nm ⌈
API Function
Header File
Description
BswM_J1939Nm_StateChange
Notification
BswM_J1939Nm.h
Notification of current J1939Nm state after state
changes.
CanIf_Transmit
CanIf.h
Requests transmission of a PDU.
Dem_SetEventStatus
Dem.h
Called by SW-Cs or BSW modules to report monitor
status information to the Dem. BSW modules calling
Dem_SetEventStatus can safely ignore the return
value. This API will be available only if ({Dem/Dem
ConfigSet/DemEventParameter/DemEvent
ReportingType} == STANDARD_REPORTING)
Nm_BusSleepMode
Nm.h
Notification that the network management has
entered Bus-Sleep Mode.
Nm_NetworkMode
Nm.h
Notification that the network management has
entered Network Mode.
Nm_StateChangeNotification
Nm.h
Notification that the state of the lower layer
<Bus>Nm has changed.
